scope: Development simulation, single writer; not release holdout or installed fixture bundle

tests.test_command: /dev-env/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests optional_tests/service optional_tests/mcp optional_tests/a2a optional_tests/homeassistant optional_tests/zenoh optional_tests/mqtt

limitations: MQTT detector is in-process; no native worker reuse claim
Graceful bridge stop is not a kill during a write
Nonce readback is device report, not independent proof of illumination
Normal command path is single writer; no exactly-once or atomic exclusion guarantee
ROS scenario wrappers, aggregate/acceptance/offline, remaining mixed faults, native resident mission, installed/exported task, frozen comparisons and external reproduction remain open

runs.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m entryplug test --suite scenarios --scenario mqtt --build
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m entryplug test --suite scenarios --scenario mqtt
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m entryplug test --suite scenarios --scenario hybrid --client session --build
